summary: Routine dependency bumps incl. NATS server 2.14.4->2.15.0, MeshCentral 1.2.5, Nushell 0.115.1 on agents.

statements.text: The agent also changed settings.py, in a way plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: Bumps NATS server, MeshCentral, Nushell versions.

statements.text: 1. Test anything that uses cryptography: 50.0.0 to 50.0.1.
2. Test anything that uses nats-py: 2.15.0 to 2.16.0.
3. Test anything that uses packaging: 25.0 to 26.3.
4. Test anything that uses psycopg: 3.3.4 to 3.3.5.
5. Test anything that uses tldextract: 5.3.1 to 5.3.2.
6. Test anything that uses uvicorn: 0.52.1 to 0.53.0.
7. Test anything that uses markdown: 3.10.2 to 3.10.3.

misses.what: NATS server (message bus to every agent) upgraded 2.14.4->2.15.0 in settings and Docker image; not stated or in test steps.
Agents will install Nushell 0.115.1 (was 0.112.2) and MeshCentral moves to 1.2.5; check scripts relying on Nushell.
